scope: development-only truth-free Doppler receiver-velocity position update for GSDC 2023 handset WLS

exact_evidence: official ION abstracts describe tightly coupled GNSS/INS, timing adjustment, adaptive weighting, and Doppler/TDCP updates
the local archive exposes pseudorange rate, satellite ECEF state, WLS position, clock discontinuity, ADR, IMU, and broadcast navigation fields
inference_not_claimed_as_evidence: a Doppler-only postprocess is not the published full winning estimator
the local diagnostics are not the hidden Kaggle score
reported public/private scores were context only and did not select parameters

frozen_contract.observation_equation: PseudorangeRate = LOS dot (satellite_velocity - receiver_velocity) + receiver_clock_range_rate; A=[-LOS,1], b=PseudorangeRate-LOS dot satellite_velocity
frozen_contract.update: one-step ECEF prediction from the previous selected finite WLS position followed by covariance-derived scalar update toward the current WLS position
frozen_contract.fail_closed: invalid Doppler, rank deficiency, excessive speed or fit RMS, clock transition, non-positive or long timestamp gap, nonfinite covariance/gain, or innovation above 30 m publishes exact WLS and resets
frozen_contract.inputs: device_gnss.csv observable fields and exact WLS POS only

train_evaluation.evaluation_source_snapshot: The initial train score was produced before the later deterministic leave-one-out consensus fix; no pre-fix source snapshot was committed.

post_score_correction_history.reason: A synthetic six-satellite unit fixture exposed that a single gross pseudorange-rate row could leave fewer than four inliers in the fixed robust screen.
post_score_correction_history.change: Added deterministic leave-one-out consensus recovery for that observable-only failure mode.

gnss_imu_timing_adaptive_weighting.reason: raw IMU is present, but no truth-free orientation/lever-arm/timestamp-offset estimator and no validated tightly coupled GNSS/INS solver are available locally; the existing causal IMU q lane is a different development-only smoother and cannot be relabeled as the winning coupled method
gnss_imu_timing_adaptive_weighting.next_safe_step: freeze and validate a route-disjoint observable timing-offset estimator before changing any position lane

raw_measurement_quality_filtering.reason: the existing adapter/WLS integrity path already enforces finite, timestamp, clock, ADR, and consistency contracts; a new raw solver would be a separate candidate requiring a new frozen train gate

road_map_matching.reason: no versioned local road graph, map tile, or route geometry asset exists; fetching OSM would violate the sealed local reproducibility contract

sealed_data_policy.fresh_validation: not opened because the train gate failed

commands.train_evaluation: python3 apps/gnss.py smartphone-doppler-position-eval --selection-record docs/use_cases/records/smartphone_r5_gsdc2023_top_solution_feasibility_audit.json --role train --route <three frozen route specs> --output-json output/smartphone-r5/doppler-position-v1/train_evaluation.json

limitations: the first Doppler train score was a No-Go despite one route improving; no fresh validation or holdout score exists
the post-consensus source fix was not rescored against truth, so it is not evidence of promotion
the candidate is not integrated into production RTK/SPP defaults and no Kaggle submission was made in this phase
